articles.content:
After pointing out this problematic feature in 15 other videos, I think it's time to take it down for good this time...

Because Discord's "join servers for you" permission is widely misused as a "ban evade for you" permission. All the horrible Discord servers that get banned can just evade server bans and restore things as if nothing happened. It is a feature that keeps Discord unsafe.

And it is almost comedic that Discord refuses to do anything about this feature. So I made an cohesive video explaining the problem in the hopes that something will happen. Whether it be Discord wising up, public pressure, or a half homunculus - half necrosed tissue government lawyer can look into it.
